clips.title: The story
paras: Stonesplinter troggs have fortified a mountain vale in southwestern Loch Modan. Their chieftain, Grawmug, leads the tribe from the valley.

Stonesplinter Valley lies among the crags of southwestern Loch Modan. Troggs clawed up from underground across Khaz Modan, ending the quiet that once filled the hollow. The Stonesplinter tribe claimed the valley and carved crude defenses into its rocky passes, digging dens and raising barricades. They hunt anything that comes too close. Their numbers threaten the roads through southern Loch Modan, and Mountaineers from Thelsamar hire mercenaries to thin their ranks and bring down Grawmug, the towering warlord who leads them.
